sobriety.title: An anchor you can't reset to zero
sobriety.tagline: A counter-anchor that survives a slip, a new phone, and a cancelled subscription.
sobriety.forWhom: For people months into sobriety who fear losing everything to a single slip.
sobriety.wedge: The growing counter you'd be terrified to reset is the genre's core product. But trackers break it themselves: a slip hard-resets years, the date can't be fixed, a new phone wipes the history, and backup sits behind a paywall. It's the #1 reason people delete. Whoever makes the anchor unbreakable takes retention outright.
sobriety.build: An accurate counter of days, money and health, plus an 'I slipped' button that marks the history instead of zeroing it. Cloud backup in the core, manual date editing, and a growth curve that shows both the slips and the overall climb.
features: An 'I slipped' button with a gentle restart, no reset
Cloud backup and transfer to a new phone — free
Manual editing of the quit date and history
A growth chart where a slip is a dot, not a catastrophe
sobriety.monetization: Counter, backup and your daily promise — free forever; paid: deeper health and money analytics.

sobriety.title: Craving SOS — free and offline
sobriety.tagline: One button on the home screen kills a craving spike — no payment, ads, or internet.
sobriety.forWhom: For the peak of an acute craving, when 'slip or not' is decided in minutes.
sobriety.wedge: People open the app exactly at a craving's peak — the genre's main scenario. Grounding, breathing and distraction work, but they're hidden behind a paywall or broken. A paywall at the moment of crisis is a fatal betrayal and a direct cause of relapse. Making the crisis kit sacred and free is the product.
sobriety.build: A big 'SOS' button on the home screen: breathing, grounding, distraction mini-games, and a craving log with triggers. Everything works offline and free.
features: An 'SOS' button right on the home screen
Breathing, grounding, distraction mini-games
A craving log recording triggers and time
Full access offline and without a subscription
sobriety.monetization: The crisis kit is free forever; paid: analysis of triggers and craving patterns over time.

sobriety.title: Like to like
sobriety.tagline: A community and a buddy for your specific addiction, with live moderation.
sobriety.forWhom: For those for whom the loneliness of addiction is heavier than the addiction itself.
sobriety.wedge: The feeling of 'I'm not alone' is the most valuable thing in recovery and the strongest retention hook. But general chats are toxic and unmoderated: bullying, harassment, everything dumped into one stream. Whoever offers matching by a specific addiction and live moderation closes a need the mass-market trackers ignore.
sobriety.build: Match buddies and rooms by a specific addiction — alcohol, porn, self-harm, sugar, doomscrolling. Live human moderation, anonymous profiles, and one-on-one accountability.
features: Match communities and buddies by a specific addiction
Live human moderation against bullying and harassment
One-on-one accountability partnership
Anonymous profiles without revealing identity
sobriety.monetization: Community and buddy are free; paid: advanced matching and private rooms.

sobriety.title: A teen tracker — no card, no age gate
sobriety.tagline: Entry with no bank card and no 18+ wall — for the very people it was built for.
sobriety.forWhom: For teens with self-harm, eating disorders and porn addiction.
sobriety.wedge: The most vulnerable in these addictions are teens, but an 18+ gate, a mandatory card and broken age checks cut them off from help. That's not a bug — it's a door shut in the target audience's face. Whoever opens entry without a card or a gate gets a niche competitors fenced off themselves.
sobriety.build: A tracker, crisis kit and gentle community built for an under-18 audience: card-free entry, minimal data, human moderation, and a focus on teen addictions.
features: Sign-up without a bank card
Access without a hard 18+ gate
Minimal data — no name, address or phone
Gentle human content moderation
sobriety.monetization: Free for minors; grants and donations instead of subscriptions.

sobriety.title: The daily ritual
sobriety.tagline: A promise to yourself in the morning and a review at night — the first and last thing of the day.
sobriety.forWhom: For people who want to weave sobriety into their routine, not just stare at a counter.
sobriety.wedge: The morning and evening ritual turns the app into a multi-year anchor and identity archive. But the journal, prompts and exercises are scattered across different apps and locked behind a paywall. Whoever assembles the ritual into one loop and keeps the core free embeds into a person's day for years.
sobriety.build: A 'morning promise → evening review' loop, daily questions and exercises, and a feed of past entries that show personal growth.
features: A promise to yourself and a reading at the start of the day
An end-of-day review before sleep
Daily questions and exercises for reflection
A feed of past entries that show personal growth
sobriety.monetization: The ritual and journal are free; paid: extended exercises and reflection themes.

sobriety.title: Science without pressure
sobriety.tagline: Cut down or quit — your choice; we explain the brain and lead in small steps.
sobriety.forWhom: For skeptics who aren't ready to quit entirely.
sobriety.wedge: A science-led, small-steps approach works even on skeptics — it's the entry point for the huge 'moderate drinkers' audience. But 'cut down' almost always turns into hidden pressure to quit completely, and a harsh streak count demoralizes those who slip. Whoever honestly leaves the goal a choice wins over the people that sobriety programs scare off.
sobriety.build: A goal choice — cut down or quit — with no bait-and-switch. An explanation of alcohol's effect on the brain, sleep and anxiety tracking, daily tasks, and progress without a demoralizing count.
features: An explanation of alcohol's effect on the brain and body
Goal choice: cut down or quit entirely
Tracking sleep and anxiety, not just the dose
Progress without a harsh resetting count
sobriety.monetization: Counter and basic science are free; paid: a personal plan and a science course.

sobriety.title: Morning motivation
sobriety.tagline: Original encouraging talks and readings — not a paid cut of someone else's videos.
sobriety.forWhom: For people who need a daily motivation boost in recovery.
sobriety.wedge: A curated content library is valued for order without the chaos of video hosts. But almost everywhere it's a resold cut of other people's clips and templated machine text, frozen for months, and pricey on top. Whoever offers original, living, regularly updated content wins on trust where competitors look like resellers.
sobriety.build: A library of original talks and readings by mood, regular updates, full recordings, and offline listening.
features: Original encouraging talks and readings for recovery
Collections by mood and morning intent
Regular updates instead of months of stagnation
Full recordings, offline, no cut-off mid-sentence
sobriety.monetization: Some content is free; a subscription unlocks the whole library with no cut-offs.
